traits.label: Cap
traits.text: 5-15 cm across. Convex, later becoming flattened or slightly depressed, with a wavy or curled margin. Its surface is rough and zoned with varying shades of reddish-brown.
traits.raw: ℹ️ Cap: 5-15 cm across. Convex, later becoming flattened or slightly depressed, with a wavy or curled margin. Its surface is rough and zoned with varying shades of reddish-brown.

traits.label: Hymenium
traits.text: Close to slightly distant gills that are adnate to slightly decurrent. Initially cream-colored, turning buff or pale ochre with age.
traits.raw: ℹ️ Hymenium: Close to slightly distant gills that are adnate to slightly decurrent. Initially cream-colored, turning buff or pale ochre with age.

traits.label: Hymenium attachment
traits.text: Adnate to slightly decurrent.
traits.raw: ℹ️ Hymenium attachment: Adnate to slightly decurrent.

traits.label: Stipe
traits.text: Cylindrical, same color as the cap or a bit lighter, sometimes with darker spots or streaks, and is often hollow in mature specimens.
traits.raw: ℹ️ Stipe: Cylindrical, same color as the cap or a bit lighter, sometimes with darker spots or streaks, and is often hollow in mature specimens.

traits.label: Spore print
traits.text: Spore Print: Cream to pale ochre.
traits.raw: ⚪🟠 Spore Print: Cream to pale ochre.

traits.label: Ecology
traits.text: Ecology: Mycorrhizal, associating predominantly with conifers but also found with birch in some regions.
traits.raw: 🌲🌳 Ecology: Mycorrhizal, associating predominantly with conifers but also found with birch in some regions.

traits.label: Odour
traits.text: Mild or slightly fruity.
traits.raw: 👃 Mild or slightly fruity.

traits.label: Edibility
traits.text: Edible, but some may find it slightly acrid or peppery to taste.
traits.raw: 🌶️😐 Edible, but some may find it slightly acrid or peppery to taste.

traits.label: Fruit body
traits.text: 5-10 cm tall.
traits.raw: 📏 5-10 cm tall.

traits.label: Microscopy
traits.text: Spores are ellipsoid, 6-8 µm x 5-6 µm, with a slightly roughened surface.
traits.raw: 🔬 Spores are ellipsoid, 6-8 µm x 5-6 µm, with a slightly roughened surface.

traits.label: Overview
traits.text: Notable for its zoned reddish-brown cap and its association with conifers. When damaged, it exudes a white latex that doesn't change color upon exposure to air.
traits.raw: 🔤 Notable for its zoned reddish-brown cap and its association with conifers. When damaged, it exudes a white latex that doesn't change color upon exposure to air.
